shortDescription: Import the primary Security Management Server database or the primary Multi-Domain Server database or the single Domain database and the applicable Check Point configuration.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: domain_ip_address
options.description:
IPv4 address for the imported Domain.
Required only for importing the Security Management Server into the Multi-Domain Server.

options.name: domain_name
options.description:
Domain name to be imported. Must be unique in the Multi-Domain Server.
Required only for importing the Security Management Server into the Multi-Domain Server.

options.name: domain_server_name
options.description:
Multi-Domain Server name for the imported Domain.
Required only for importing the Security Management Server into the Multi-Domain Server.

options.name: file_path
options.description: Path to the exported database file to be imported.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Ignoring the verification warnings. By Setting this parameter to 'true' import will not be blocked by warnings.

options.name: include_endpoint_configuration
options.description: Include import of the Endpoint Security Management configuration files.

options.name: include_endpoint_database
options.description: Include import of the Endpoint Security Management database.

options.name: keep_cloud_sharing
options.description:
Preserve the connection of the Management Server to Check Point's Infinity Portal.
Use this flag after ensuring that the original Management Server does not communicate with Infinity Portal.
Note, resuming the connection is also possible after import with set-cloud-services. Available from R81.20 management version.

options.name: pre_import_verification_only
options.description: If true, only runs the pre-import verifications instead of the full import.

options.name: verify_domain_restore
options.description:
If true, verify that the restore operation is valid for this input file and this environment.
Note, Restore operation will not be executed.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
